data.name: Kasper
data.gender_notes: Kasper is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'casparis' meaning 'carrying, bringing forth'. This name is associated with the biblical figure Kasper, one of the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus. The name Kasper carries the meaning “Carrying, Bringing Forth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kasper usually hope their child will grow to embody carrying, bringing forth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the journey of bringing forth new ideas, experiences, and wisdom into the world.
data.etymology: Kasper belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Carrying, Bringing Forth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kasper total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Kasper is a name that represents the journey of the Magi, or three wise men, in their search for the newborn king. Its use in Christian families symbolizes a sense of wonder, curiosity, and the pursuit of knowledge that leads us to the greatest treasure of all - the wisdom and love of God.
data.spiritual_significance: Named after the wise and faithful biblical figure Kasper, this name motivates the bearer to be wise and pious in their knowledge of God. The spiritual significance of the name Kasper is a commitment to seek the wisdom and love of God, to remain on a lifelong pilgrimage of faith, and to bring the message of love and joy to others.
